<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 134.10955, the neutral mass matches the exact mass of C₁₀H₁₄ (10 × 12.000 + 14 × 1.007825 = 134.10955). No hetero‑atoms are required to explain the observed mass, so the molecular formula is C10H14.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14</final_answer>
